cards.name: Bleed Dry
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

cards.name: Bleeding Effect
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, creatures you control gain flying until end of turn if a creature card in your graveyard has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.

cards.name: Bleeding Edge
cards.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Amass Zombies 2. (Put two +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. It's also a Zombie. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token first.)
